english_text: Today 's Spanish press widely reports the adoption last week of a memorial in the House of Representatives and Senate of the State of Idaho , in the United States . They unanimously approved a joint memorial which calls for peace in the Basque country . The Idaho legislature - and I quote : - `` stands with the Basques in opposing all violence in the Basque Country and calling for the immediate convocation of a process [ between the governments of Spain and France ] to bring about lasting peace ( ... ) this memorial expresses Idaho 's support of the right of the Basques to self-determination . ''
